column1: # In a .rs file, does this LINE reach a user? — must-match / must-not-match.
# The path test says the file ships; this says the line is READ. Same split, same
# spelling, as check_no_claim_literals.sh, which applies its ratio pattern to print
# macros and to ///|//! doc comments (published by cargo doc) and to nothing else in .rs.
# WHY THE SPLIT IS LOAD-BEARING HERE. Measured over 300 commits of origin/main, every
# comparative claim this repository added to a plain `//` comment was a claim it was
# WITHDRAWING — `// #2696: this printed "Performance: 800+ tok/s (2.8x Ollama)"`. B4's
# remedy is a recorded comparator command, version and log; there is no log for a number
# nobody measured, so a block on those lines has no honest exit. Fixture row 22 carries
# both forms in ONE file, comment first, so the rejection reason proves which fired.
